cropDiagnoses.primaryIssue: Fall Armyworm Whorl Damage (सैनिक कीट)

actionableSteps: Manually collect and destroy visible larvae and heavily damaged whorls if the infestation area is small.
Apply fine sand, dry soil, or wood ash mixed with lime into the affected maize whorls to dehydrate and deter the larvae.
Release natural predators or parasitoids such as Trichogramma species if recommended by local extension services.
preventativeMeasures: Adopt deep summer ploughing to expose pupae to sunlight and predatory birds.
Intercrop maize with pulses like cowpea or pigeon pea (arhar) to attract beneficial insects and confuse pests.
Install pheromone traps at a rate of 5 traps per acre for mass trapping and early monitoring of male moths.

cropDiagnoses.escalationNotes: Infestation is located directly inside the growing tip (whorl) with high severity. If over 10-15% of plants show similar symptoms, immediate expert consultation with KVK is required for safe bio-pesticide recommendations.
